lines.speaker: vault_holdout
lines.text: Do not touch the last door. I have been not touching it for eleven years and I would like that to continue.

lines.speaker: vault_holdout
lines.text: My grandfather sealed it. From the inside, then out through the service side, which took him four days. There are documents behind there that people were killed for in his century.

lines.speaker: vault_holdout
lines.text: You are going to open it. Everyone who comes down here is going to open it. I just like to be on record as having said.

lines.speaker: vault_holdout
lines.text: Well. It is open. I have been down there and it is nine pages and five signatures and I do not understand why anybody died for it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Because it is the only copy that says who agreed to it.
